description: Garuda Linux with the Dr460nized KDE Plasma desktop. A flamboyant Arch-based gaming distro: Btrfs snapshots that undo bad updates from the boot menu, a gaming app store, and a neon look that is anything but subtle.

maintainer.note: Catalog-only entry: no install plugin yet. downloadUrl points at the official download portal; pin a direct ISO URL and SHA-256 checksum when the plugin is written.
